script_text: Taurus, this week your Venus-ruled earth nature gets a money-and-voice jolt, not a slow romance crawl. Tuesday into Wednesday, Mercury in your 3rd trines Saturn in the 11th, so a group email or contract can lock cash terms. Mars in the 3rd is trining Saturn, making Tuesday sharp for interviews and paperwork. Wednesday turns because Venus enters Cancer, your 3rd House, while Saturn turns retrograde in Pisces in the 11th, moving love from flirting to commitments with friends. By Sunday, the Sun enters Cancer, lighting your 3rd House of messages, proposals, and negotiations. A single Taurus may spark through writing; a partnered Taurus can clear a money misunderstanding. Friday is your power day because Mars trines Saturn for career strategy. Tuesday is your worst day because the Moon in Gemini squares Saturn, stirring spending anxiety. Budget surprises, then send the pitch. Follow for daily updates.
